Done. Final summary:

**Method**
- Replayed stock + each single change on all 5 traces, then canaried stock + each single change to fit production's trace mix (weights ≈ R1 0.25, R2 0.09, R3 0.32, R4 0.04, R5 0.29; fit residuals ≈ 0.1%).
- Independence predictions turned out unreliable — C-203 has strong positive synergies (with C-127/C-241) and C-352 conflicts with C-127 — so I replayed **every** cost-feasible set (all 27) on all 5 traces and ranked them by production-weighted latency.
- Added reps (6 each) on stock and the winner across all traces, plus extra canary reps, to tighten the estimate.

**Result** (`/app/plan.json`, 314/320 credits used):
- `opts`: **C-127, C-203, C-241** (11 review-days) — measured speedup ≈ **1.99–2.00×**, well ahead of the runner-up (C-114+C-127+C-203 at 1.73×).
- `speedup`: **[1.94, 2.05]** (width ≈ 5.5% of truth; the two weighting fits gave 1.986 and 2.000, bootstrap 99% range 1.97–2.03).
- `weakest`: **C-241** — removing it drops speedup to 1.64×, vs. 1.50× without C-203 and 1.33× without C-127.
